scripts.scan:banned: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const {execSync}=require('child_process');const files=execSync('git ls-files -z').toString().split('\0').filter(Boolean).filter(f=>!f.includes('package.json')&&!f.includes('package-lock.json')&&!f.includes('reports/')&&!f.includes('node_modules/'));const bad=/(iota|tangle|did|firefly|shimmer|hornet|stardust|wallet\.rs|identity\.rs|streams)/i;const hits=[];for(const f of files){try{const t=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(bad.test(t))hits.push(f);}catch{}}if(hits.length){console.error('BANNED TERMS FOUND:\n'+hits.join('\n'));process.exit(1)}console.log('No banned terms.')"
